exposure: maternal antepartum antibiotic administration (type, duration, total number)
cohort: 79 women and 90 preterm neonates (23 weeks 0 days to 28 weeks 6 days gestation) admitted to the NICU at a single tertiary care center over 5 years.
finding: Neonates with antibiotic-resistant bacterial isolates were more likely to be born at lower gestational ages and have lower mean birth weights, and these resistant bacteria often corresponded to antibiotics received by their mothers antepartum.
gest_age: 23 weeks 0 days to 28 weeks 6 days (range), 24.6 to 25.9 weeks (mean)
